services.name: Massage Therapist
services.desc: In January 2002, Jennifer Ketchum founded Great Lakes Clinical Massage Therapy. A graduate and former instructor at Blue Heron Academy, Jen is nationally board certified and brings extensive experience and clinical expertise to her practice. She is dedicated to providing high-quality, therapeutic massage focused on client comfort, healing, and long-term wellness, using a thoughtful and individualized approach to care. Logan Robinson graduated from the Pacific Northwest Massage Academy in Vancouver, WA, where he developed a strong foundation in therapeutic bodywork.
